title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline
author: Ethan Park
release_notes: Adds profiling baselines and a new reporting pipeline for benchmark-lab. Exposes baseline artifacts for perf regression detection and uploads summarized metrics to the metrics-store & the benchmark dashboards.
description: Context: benchmark-lab needs stable profiling baselines and an automated reporting pipeline so that nightly/PR workloads can detect regressions in latency, memory/KV-cache behavior, and token throughput. This PR introduces: 1) a profiling baseline harness that captures representative workload traces (chat-completion, streaming, embeddings) with deterministic seeds; 2) a new representative workload runner for 'rep-chat-heavy' and 'rep-embed-small' that can be used in CI and nightly runs; 3) a reporting pipeline job that aggregates profiler outputs, computes summary stats (p50/p95/p99 latency, peak-resident-memory, token-throughput), and uploads a JSON artifact to the metrics-store & the benchmark dashboards; 4) small infra/ci changes to run a lightweight smoke profiling job on PRs and a full run in nightly builds. Motivation: we've had a few incidents where kernel selection regressions caused noticeable p95 latency increases for long-context streaming chat. Having baseline traces and automated comparisons will let us alert and roll back faster. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling harness and baseline schema (benchmarks/profiling/baseline_v1.json) - [x] Add representative workload runners (benchmark-lab/runners/rep_chat_heavy.py, rep_embed_small.py) - [x] Add reporting pipeline job (ci/pipelines/benchmark-reporting.yml) - [x] Add docs + README with how to reproduce local runs (benchmark-lab/README.md) - [x] Add unit tests for reporter and schema validation (benchmark-lab/tests/test_reporter.py) Notes: - This PR intentionally outputs baseline artifacts in a stable JSON schema (versioned) so future tooling can diff and compute regression alerts. - The full nightly run is larger and will be scheduled by the infra team; this change only wires the pipeline and adds the lightweight PR check. - See Linear ENG-1872 for rollout plan and ENG-1880 for dashboard integration. How to run locally: 1) ./benchmark-lab/run_rep_runner.sh --workload rep-chat-heavy --output local_output.json 2) ./benchmark-lab/profiling/generate_baseline.sh --trace local_output.json --baseline out/baseline_v1.json 3) pytest benchmark-lab/tests --profile-coverage Expected impact: improved detection of perf regressions, reduced time-to-detect for kernel/quantization regressions, and better observability in the dashboard.
